subject: API model phasing: decision capture & exemption path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia@nebulasoft.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@nebulasoft.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: API model phasing: decision capture & exemption path

Team / Sofia —

Quick context: as discussed in product sync last week, we need to finalize the phasing plan for the v1->v2 model surface (chat+completion endpoints). The current proposal in the deck targets a soft-deprecation window that starts 2027-02-01 with a 60-day notice and a 180-day compatibility grace for enterprise contracts. Before we publish notice, we need:

- A clear exemption intake process (owner, SLA to respond, form)
- A short decision capture for each impacted account (timeline + channel)
- Alignment on comm cadence (customer notice, follow-ups, CS enablement)

Attached: deprecation-impact-spreadsheet.xlsx (breaks customers by traffic, usage patterns, existing pin/variants).

Asks:
- Ben: can your team run the impacted-account outreach plan (template + sequencing) if we lock dates by EOW Nov 27?
- Rishi: confirm if routing/fallback policy can be in place to preserve latency SLOs during rollout (we may need a soft-capacity reservation).
- Irene: want product to sign off on exemption criteria (technical/contractual). I pushed a draft intake doc to Drive; link below.

Sofia / Contracts Team — if NebulaSoft needs a longer runway, please outline the ask here (preferred dates + reason). We'll route exemption requests through the form once the process is live.

Thanks — short bullets appreciated.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — I'm available to own outreach. Proposed plan:

1) Week of Nov 29: send personalized notice to top-50 impacted accounts (account exec + customer success looped).
2) Week of Dec 6: 1:1 outreach for any high-usage accounts flagged in the spreadsheet.
3) Dec 13–20: intake form open for exemptions; triage weekly via a small committee (Sales/CS/Product/Legal).

Can do the initial notices if Product confirms final dates by Friday (Nov 27). Template is ready; I attached a sample to the Drive doc (internal).

Rishi — on routing: if we need reserved capacity, give me a rough capacity delta (qps) by Dec 2 and I'll start the allocation conversation with infra.

Ben

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Appreciate the heads up and the spreadsheet. NebulaSoft's integration is deeply embedded (server-side batch scoring + streaming responses). We can adapt, but our procurement cycle and security QA mean we need a longer runway than 180 days. Requesting an exemption/grace period through 2027-11-01 (approx 11 months) to complete revalidation and retesting across our environments.

High level:
- Technical: we use pinned endpoints and have on-prem bridges in a handful of regions. Migration involves a model-variant change and additional validation of tokenization differences.
- Commercial: we have an annual renewal tied to this integration; any short notice forces contractual conversations with procurement.

If you open the exemption-triage form, we'll submit the details. For now, accept this email as notice and request for extended runway. We'd prefer a short sync with Product + CS to surface blocker areas — suggested time: Nov 30 (US morning).

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Integrations, NebulaSoft
sofia@nebulasoft.com

---- Forwarded message included above ----

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia@nebulasoft.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 05:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: API model phasing: decision capture & exemption path

Thanks all — good signal. Two quick decisions from Product: 

1) Exemption process: we will require the filled exemption-form.pdf (attached) + a technical impact statement. Intake owner: Product Ops (Marissa) — SLA to respond: 7 business days for completeness, 14 business days for final decision or conditional approval.

2) Timeline: locked proposal is still 2027-02-01 start of notice, but we will handle enterprise exceptions on a case-by-case basis. Any request that asks for >9 months will require an escalation to Pricing & Legal and must be routed through Contracts.

Marissa — please publish the intake form (PDF attached) to the Drive link and kick off the top-50 notices on Nov 29 as Ben suggested. Also schedule a stakeholder sync Nov 30 (30 min) to walk NebulaSoft and any other at-risk accounts through the technical checklist. Ben — prepare CS talking points and an opt-in cadence for accounts that want to enroll in an extended testing lane. Rishi — can you confirm by EOD Dec 2 whether we can do a soft reserved capacity for flagged accounts? If not, we need an alternative fallback plan (model-variant routing).

Sofia — we'll hold Nov 30 morning; Marissa will send time options. Please submit the exemption form afterward and we'll triage.

—Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Product Management, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
